title: Resolve a quantum measurement without hiding its cost
description: Choose a backend and shot budget. Watch statistical uncertainty, device bias, and total circuit work change together.

backends.label: Ideal simulator
backends.detail: No hardware noise; useful for checking circuit logic, not hardware advantage.

backends.label: Noisy device
backends.detail: Readout and decoherence shrink the observable signal toward zero.

backends.label: Mitigated device
backends.detail: Error mitigation recovers part of the signal by executing extra circuit variants.
